fusions.name: Across the Table
fusions.desc: Leaps up to 7 tiles onto the target and stabs it, dealing 12 damage and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Pinhole Bites
fusions.desc: A quick nip with the knife-tip that deals 7 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. Also costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Hop and Nick
fusions.desc: You spring 3 tiles forward and gain 25% critical hit chance for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Restless Legs
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, your next strike gains 15% critical hit chance. Once every 8 seconds.
